Done. Summary:

**Built `ApprovalMatrixConfigPage`** — a Tenant Admin-only settings screen for configuring approval matrix rules:
- `src/pages/ApprovalMatrixConfigPage.jsx` — route at `/settings/approval-matrix-config`, gated to `TENANT_ADMIN`, with loading/empty/error(+retry)/populated states
- `src/features/approvals/components/ApprovalMatrixRuleCard.jsx` — editable rule card (Contract Type, Value Min/Max, Risk Band Min/Max, ordered approval steps)
- `src/services/approvalMatrixConfigService.js` + two hooks (`useApprovalMatrixConfig`, `useUpdateApprovalMatrixConfig`), calling only `GET`/`PUT /api/v1/approval-matrix-config`
- Test file `src/__tests__/ApprovalMatrixConfigPage.test.jsx` (6 tests, all passing)
- Route added to `App.jsx`

**Verified:** lint clean, 47/47 tests pass, production build succeeds, and I screenshotted the live page against a temporary local mock backend — it renders correctly with the repo's existing dark-theme Settings-page style.

**Key blocker:** none of the three TARGET DESIGN images actually show this page — they depict the Approvals list and Approval Review screens (owned by other tasks). I built this screen by extending the repo's existing settings-page visual language instead of inventing one, and flagged this plus a few inferred fields (free-text Contract Type, client-generated UUIDs for new rules, no `approverUserId` editor) in the output's `blockers`. Status is `PARTIAL` for that reason. Full details are in `.ui-gen/outputs/T-APPROVAL-MATRIX-CONFIG-PAGE-UI.json`.

tool_input.command: find .ui-gen -iname "*.json" -path "*output*"; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -iname "*.json" -path "*ui-gen*outputs*" -print 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "T-*-UI.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

nohup npm run dev -- --port 5199 --strictPort > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &
disown
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5199/settings/approval-matrix-config
cat /tmp/vite.log
